Dear Operations,

MV VALDA CREST - Rotterdam, Rijnmond Energy Coal Terminal

The coal berth will be free from 26 Jan 0100 UTC, a few hours after the vessel's ETA, once the vessel ahead has sailed.

Please keep us informed of the vessel's ETA.

Best regards,
Operations desk
Maasport Agencies, Rotterdam
